exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Not shortlisted. Classic CAN only, with the MCP2515 core's 2 receive buffers, the same as rank 3; the data sheet was fetched but not qualified. Five survivors at most.
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The link-controller shortlist has 3 entries, so a cap of 5 does not exclude it. P2 kept the MCP2515 (rank 3) because V16 feeds Q8 only, and the same 2-buffer figure applies here. DS20005282C (https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/OTH/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/MCP25625-CAN-Controller-Data-Sheet-20005282C.pdf, read 2026-09-28T13:26:12Z) gives the values P2 did not qualify. The controller's TxCAN and RxCAN are separate pins, and the transceiver's TXD and RXD 'must be externally connected' to them (section 1.3), so the RXCAN and TXCAN test points of IOBoard.md:540 exist, unlike on TCAN4550. VIO sets 3.3 V logic ('Interfaces Directly with Microcontrollers with 2.7V to 5.5V I/Os'); VDDA 4.5 to 5.5 V from the 5 V rail; CANH, CANL -58 to +58 V; tTXD-RXD 235 ns max; up to 1 Mb/s. JLCPCB 2398, presale 2348, 1.9017 USD at 1 (2026-09-28T13:21:57Z). Digi-Key 3513, Active, lead 49 weeks (2026-09-28T13:22:52Z). Microchip page In Production (2026-09-28T13:25:39Z). It qualifies as a link controller on the same terms as rank 3, with the transceiver built in.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: No second source (rule 5): Digi-Key stock 0 (2026-09-28T13:05:27Z); SN65HVD230D is Obsolete at Digi-Key and on the TI page; no pin-compatible alternate (pin 5 Vref, pin 8 Rs).
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The Digi-Key figure holds: 0, Active (2026-09-28T13:22:18Z). The claim of no alternate does not. SN65HVD232DR shares SLOS346O (read 2026-09-28T13:24:06Z) and pins 1 to 4, 6 and 7. Its pins 5 and 8 are NC. The 1 Mbit/s link runs the '230 in high-speed mode with RS at 0 V and does not use Vref, so the '232 fits the same circuit. Whether grounding NC pin 8 is permitted is not stated and is for P4 to check. SN65HVD232DR has JLCPCB 42376, presale 41910 (2026-09-28T13:21:47Z), which passes rules 1 to 4. Digi-Key also holds 471 (13:22:22Z). A second route is MAX3051ESA+T (C15648). It shares pin 8 RS and pins 1 to 4, 6 and 7. Its pin 5 is SHDN with a 50 to 100 kOhm pull-down, so it stays in normal mode where the '230's Vref is left open. JLCPCB 13589 (13:21:48Z), data sheet 19-3274 Rev 5 (13:28:37Z). The SN65HVD230DR therefore has a rule-5 alternate.

exclusions_not_holding.part: TJA1044T/1Z (C520388), SN65HVD1050DR, SN65HVD251DR, MCP2551-I/SN, Link CAN transceiver
exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Not qualified. JLCPCB descriptions give a 5 V supply with no VIO pin, so RXD would be at 5 V against 3.3 V logic (IOBoard.md:175). Datasheets not read.
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The drop stands on a different source. IOBoard.md:175 limits outputs that reach an RP2354B pin, and with an SPI controller the transceiver's RXD reaches the controller instead. The limit that applies is the controller's. MCP2518FD DS20006027B section 7.1 gives 'DC Voltage at all I/O w.r.t GND -0.3V to VDD + 0.3V' (read 2026-09-28T13:26:13Z), which is 3.6 V at VDD 3.3 V, so a 5 V RXD on RXCAN is out of rating. The part values must come from datasheets, not JLCPCB descriptions. TJA1044 Rev. 8.0 Table 3 (read 13:25:03Z) confirms pin 5 is n.c. on TJA1044T. The same table gives a VIO pin on TJA1044GT/3, which P2 missed (see the missed entries).

The JLCPCB API labels it 'Texas Instruments' (2026-09-28T13:21:58Z); JLCPCB holds 6513, and Digi-Key 547, Active (13:23:01Z). The drop stands on the datasheet. SLLSEZ4A (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tcan4551-q1.pdf, read 2026-09-28T13:24:08Z) lists normal, standby and sleep modes, with the RST pin only as a reset pulse ('Set high to reset device. TCAN4550 SLLSF91A section 8.3.8 says the same: RST pulsed high for at least tPULSE_WIDTH, 30 us, resets the device into standby.
